meta_description:
shivya on September 27, 2026: "When can we finally stop choosing between our freedom and safety?

When will public spaces be closed to predators instead of us? 

For how long do we need to be outraged before we’re granted our most basic rights?

How many more times will we be told to stay home to protect ourselves? 

When will be able to go out at night without having to watch our backs?

How long will we have to defend our right to wear what we want without being told ‘we’re asking for it?’

When will be able to say goodbye without saying, message me when you get home?

When will we live in a world where questions like this no longer need to be asked?".
